name: chikas-game-hub
description: Chika's Game Hub - educational gaming platform for children ages 4-12

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,gateway,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w gateway
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w gateway
